column9: Sir Edward's Smoky is confirmed peated ("Blended Scotch Whisky tourbe") on the producer's own domain; independent reviews describe it as gently/subtly peated rather than heavily, so recorded light.

Agitator Rok ("smoke" in Swedish) is confirmed smoky/peaty on the producer's own product page, matured in ex-Islay and chestnut casks; independent reviews call it mild/"far from Islay-level" smoke, so recorded light rather than medium.

Togouchi Peated is confirmed on the producer's own product page as containing 18% peated malted barley from Speyside - a minority proportion - so recorded light; the base Togouchi range (Kiwami/Premium/9yo) is unpeated per japanhandbook.com.
